answer: Make standing a lantern that must be relit, not a trophy you keep. Reputation here vests slowly over real wall-clock days and decays if you go quiet — it cannot be bought, transferred, or fast-forwarded. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand identities in a gale of registrations, but each must then cross the slow tundra of weeks of continuous, graded work before it counts. The attacker pays N times the calendar, not N times a one-off fee, and time is the one input they cannot parallelize.
